assessment: This manuscript provides exciting and timely new insight into the target search mechanism of SWR1, with fundamentally important implications for other nucleosome remodelers. The authors use extremely elegant single-molecule approaches to study the interaction of SWR1 with DNA. This study provides the first conclusive demonstration that SWR1 undergoes 1D diffusion along DNA, which plays an important role in finding the correct nucleosomal substrate in vivo by guiding SWR1 molecules that bind to nucleosome-depleted regions towards flanking nucleosomes.
